_comment: Slack app manifest for the dedicated alert app. Config (no secret) — committable. Create the app with: curl -s -F token=$XOXE_CONFIG_TOKEN -F manifest=@proximal-alerts.slack-manifest.json https://slack.com/api/apps.manifest.create  (the xoxe.xoxp- config token is minted at api.slack.com/apps; ~12h TTL). After create, install to the gearheads workspace and add an Incoming Webhook to #proximal-alerts (api.slack.com/apps -> proximal-alerts -> Incoming Webhooks -> Add New Webhook to Workspace). The webhook URL is the secret -> /etc/alertmanager/slack_webhook_url (see slack_webhook_url.template). Isolated from the praxis app on purpose.

display_information.description: Prometheus Alertmanager notifications for host proximal (observability subsystem).
